description: This file defines the RetrievePolicyIdStrategy class, which handles the RetrievePolicyId command in a persistent actor based on the Ditto framework; it encapsulates logic to retrieve a policy ID from a Thing entity, generate appropriate results, and manage entity tags.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyIdStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the RetrievePolicyId command by extracting the policy ID from a Thing and creating a result or error accordingly.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command logic to retrieve the PolicyId from a Thing, building a successful or error result.

methods.name: extractPolicyId
methods.description: Helper method that obtains the PolicyId from a given Thing entity.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous entity, if any.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the new entity based on its policy ID.
